reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides Playwright-based browser automation with semantic interaction, bounded page observation, tab management, navigation, and screenshots.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化，包括语义化页面交互、页面快照、标签页管理、导航和截图。
summaries.en: Provides Playwright-based browser automation for DeepSeek Harness, including semantic page interaction, bounded snapshots, tab management, navigation, and screenshots.

capabilities: Reads bounded accessibility or visible-text snapshots
Interacts with semantic page targets using clicks, form filling, and keyboard input
Waits for page conditions and manages browser history
Maintains a reusable browser context with explicit tab management
